scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ainide/shared && PORT=${PORT:-43127} concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @ainide/server" "sh -c 'until nc -z 127.0.0.1 \$PORT >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.1; done; npm run dev -w @ainide/web'"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ainide/shared && npm run build -w @ainide/server && npm run build -w @ainide/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ainide/shared && npm run test -w @ainide/server && npm run test -w @ainide/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ainide/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ainide/server && npm run typecheck -w @ainide/web
